about_the_game:
Battlecaster is a top-down arena roguelike, fighting against challenging waves of enemies. Each enemy is lethal and can end your run quickly. Learn fast and think on your feet.

3 year anniversary - Re-release coming!

In anticipation for the 3 year anniversary of Battlecaster, the game has received a major overhaul, with a brand new weapon system, inventory overhaul, and addition of a campaign map. 

A demo will be made available in early May, and purchases will be re-enabled after a period of testing and addressing player feedback.

Make strategic use of your powerful abilities to control the field and survive. After each round you'll have your pick from a handful of rewards to gain power, maximize your build and stats to be most effective in combat.

Features:

  • Roguelike Arena Rush – You've found yourself in the heart of the storm. Defend yourself in an abyssal arena or die trying.

  • Fast-paced action – Display combat prowess and moment to moment decision making or face certain doom. You will be challenged by relentless enemies who will not give you an inch of breathing room.

  • Develop an arsenal – Collect powerful items and upgrades along the way to gain your advantage.

Gameplay

  • Roguelike gameplay – Every run is different and small decisions will have large impacts on your success.

  • 10 enemies – Each acting filling a unique 'chess piece' role in the ring.

  • 50+ items – Arm yourself with the equipment of heroes fallen before you.

  • Endless waves – Increasingly difficult challenges to survive through.

  • A true challenge.

name: BATTLECASTER

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Dual Core 2.4 GHz
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 1GB VRAM / DirectX 10+ support
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Dual Core 3.0 GHz+
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 2GB VRAM / DirectX 10+ support
  • Storage: 5 GB available space

short_description: BATTLECASTER is a challenging fast paced arena roguelike. Defend yourself against unrelenting enemies and overcome difficult encounters. Use abilities strategically to control the ring of combat.
